scope: Kernel supervisor schema readiness before API/worker process creation
result: focused source/profile checks and bounded ARM64 QEMU runtime acceptance passed
changes: Default and OIDC image runtime commands require schema readiness.
Standard API and worker Compose commands require schema readiness.
A failed readiness check exits before child processes are spawned.

checks.command: POSTGRES_PASSWORD=compose-test-only docker compose --env-file /dev/null -f docker-compose.kernel-candidate.yml -f docker-compose.kernel-standard.yml config --format json

arm64_qemu_runtime.empty_ledger: readiness failed and no API/scheduler/event child started
arm64_qemu_runtime.after_migration: API, scheduler, and event children started

limitations: This does not establish physical Raspberry Pi behavior or MAN-CAP acceptance.
The bounded QEMU runtime is not a performance benchmark; long-duration recovery, provider outage, power-loss, and replica acceptance remain open.
